changelog: One set of review markup on the product page: WooCommerce's Product carries the aggregateRating (WooCommerce's average and counts) and the reviews on the list's first page (at most 10) as the page shows them, and WooCommerce's separate review entries are dropped. Held, investigated, rejected and unmatched imported reviews aren't included; with nothing rated, there's no aggregate.

The Google Merchant Center product review feed (schema 2.4), off until "Build the feed" is on: built daily in Action Scheduler, 200 reviews a batch, into uploads/creviews-feed/ behind a deny-all guard, and served at /?creviews-feed=<key> with Last-Modified and 304s. Each review carries its reviewer's display name, time, title, words, address, rating, photos, language, verified purchase, incentive, collection method and order, and its product's GTIN (checked by its check digit), SKU, MPN (_creviews_mpn) and WooCommerce brand. Staff reviews and reviews without words are left out.

The settings show the feed's reviews against Google's 50, the last build and fetch, the feed's address, the reviewed products missing a GTIN or brand, and a warning when the site's address can't go in a feed.
